title: A new sport debuts at the Winter Olympics
titleChinese: 冬季奥林匹克运动会迎来新项目
paragraphs: How do you fancy being up a mountain at a height of around 3,000 metres with the temperature below zero, snow underfoot, variable weather, racing up and downhill? This is how some athletes will be competing in this year's winter Olympics.

Skimo, short for ski mountaineering, is the newest winter Olympic sport and will debut at the 2026 games in Milan-Cortina. It combines Alpine skiing with mountaineering and is a race against time where athletes are required to ascend and descend mountainous terrain using skis and other specialised equipment.

At the Olympics, there will be a relay event, and also a sprint competition which lasts just a few minutes. Athletes start in a steep uphill section using climbing skins. These are detachable grippy strips you attach to skis to prevent sliding. The athletes then rapidly transition to boot packing where skis are carried on a backpack as they run up an incline as fast as possible. There is then a technical downhill course full of tight turns and obstacles. Because of all the transitions, races can be won or lost in seconds depending on how smoothly the athletes can switch between modes.

One hopeful British qualifier, and a member of the GB Skimo squad, is Iain Innes. Despite the sport being included in the Olympics, which he says is great news, he doesn't think the events accurately represent ski mountaineering. "There is no element of mountaineering whatsoever, as the World Cups and Olympics are held on man-made slopes with berms and jumps and perfectly cut steps on the climbs", he told the British Mountaineering Council.

However, inclusion in the Olympics is a positive reflection of the sport's global growth and development. The International Ski Mountaineering Federation (ISMF) oversees the regulation and promotion of the sport and has established a World Cup circuit, as well as continental and World Championships, all of which have helped elevate the sport's standing. So, look out for this extreme sport this year and feel that adrenaline rush.
chineseParagraphs: 身处海拔约3000米的高山上，气温低于零度，脚下是积雪，天气变幻莫测，需要竞速上坡和下坡，你觉得怎么样？这就是一些运动员将在今年冬季奥运会上比赛的方式。
Skimo，即滑雪登山，是冬季奥运会的最新项目，将在2026年米兰-科尔蒂纳奥运会上首次亮相。它将高山滑雪与登山相结合，是一场与时间的赛跑，要求运动员使用滑雪板和其他专业装备在山区地形中上坡和下坡。
在奥运会上，将设有接力赛，以及仅持续几分钟的短距离竞速赛。运动员从陡峭的上坡路段开始，使用登山爬升辅助带。这些是可拆卸的防滑条，固定在滑雪板底部以防止滑倒。然后，运动员迅速转换为“boot packing”模式，即把滑雪板背在背包上，在斜坡上尽可能快地奔跑。接下来是充满急转弯和障碍物的技术性下坡赛道。由于所有这些转换，几秒钟就能决定比赛的胜负，取决于运动员在各模式间切换的流畅程度。
伊恩·英尼斯是英国滑雪登山队的一员，也是有希望获得奥运资格的选手之一。尽管他认为这项运动被纳入奥运会是个好消息，但他并不认为奥运项目能准确代表滑雪登山运动。他告诉英国登山理事会：“奥运和世界杯比赛都在人造斜坡上举行，设有护堤、跳跃点和攀登时切割完美的台阶，完全没有登山的元素。”
然而，被纳入奥运会是这项运动在全球成长和发展的正面反馈。国际滑雪登山联合会负责监督和推广这项运动，并建立了世界杯巡回赛以及洲际和世界锦标赛，所有这些都有助于提升这项运动的地位。所以，今年请关注这项极限运动，感受那份肾上腺素飙升的刺激。

vocabulary.entry: fancy /ˈfænsi/ v. 想要，想做（英式口语）
vocabulary.example: Do you fancy going for a drink after work?
vocabulary.translation: 你想下班后去喝一杯吗？

vocabulary.entry: variable /ˈveəriəbl/ adj. 多变的，易变的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The weather here is very variable.
vocabulary.translation: 这里的天气变化无常。

vocabulary.definition: /n. 首次亮相，初次登场（书面语）
vocabulary.entry: debut /ˈdeɪbjuː/ v. /n. 首次亮相，初次登场（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The new model will make its debut at the motor show.
vocabulary.translation: 这款新车型将在车展上首次亮相。

vocabulary.entry: mountaineering /ˌmaʊntəˈnɪərɪŋ/ n. 登山运动
vocabulary.example: Mountaineering requires physical strength and mental resilience.
vocabulary.translation: 登山需要体力和心理韧性。

vocabulary.entry: ascend /əˈsend/ v. 上升，攀登（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She ascended the stairs slowly.
vocabulary.translation: 她慢慢地走上楼梯。

vocabulary.entry: descend /dɪˈsend/ v. 下降，下坡（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The path descends steeply to the valley.
vocabulary.translation: 小径陡峭地向下通往山谷。

vocabulary.entry: terrain /təˈreɪn/ n. 地形，地势（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The car is designed to handle rough terrain.
vocabulary.translation: 这辆车是为应对崎岖地形而设计的。

vocabulary.entry: specialised /ˈspeʃəlaɪzd/ adj. 专业的，专门的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The work requires specialised knowledge.
vocabulary.translation: 这项工作需要专业知识。

vocabulary.entry: relay /ˈriːleɪ/ n. 接力赛
vocabulary.example: She ran the last leg of the relay.
vocabulary.translation: 她跑了接力赛的最后一棒。

vocabulary.entry: sprint /sprɪnt/ n. 短跑，冲刺
vocabulary.example: He broke into a sprint to catch the bus.
vocabulary.translation: 他冲刺起来赶公交车。

vocabulary.entry: steep /stiːp/ adj. 陡峭的
vocabulary.example: The hill is too steep to cycle up.
vocabulary.translation: 这山太陡了，骑不上去。

vocabulary.entry: detachable /dɪˈtætʃəbl/ adj. 可拆卸的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The laptop has a detachable keyboard.
vocabulary.translation: 这款笔记本电脑有一个可拆卸键盘。

vocabulary.entry: grippy /ˈɡrɪpi/ adj. 防滑的，有抓力的（口语）
vocabulary.example: These gloves have grippy palms.
vocabulary.translation: 这些手套的手掌有防滑设计。

vocabulary.entry: strip /strɪp/ n. 条，带
vocabulary.example: A strip of paper was stuck to the door.
vocabulary.translation: 一条纸贴在门上。

vocabulary.entry: slide /slaɪd/ v. 滑动，滑行
vocabulary.example: The children were sliding on the ice.
vocabulary.translation: 孩子们在冰上滑行。

vocabulary.entry: transition /trænˈzɪʃn/ v. /n. 过渡，转变（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She transitioned from full-time work to freelance writing.
vocabulary.translation: 她从全职工作过渡到自由写作。

vocabulary.entry: boot packing /ˈbuːt ˌpækɪŋ/ n. 雪地徒步（滑雪术语）
vocabulary.example: Boot packing is often necessary in deep snow.
vocabulary.translation: 在深雪中常常需要雪地徒步。

vocabulary.entry: incline /ˈɪnklaɪn/ n. 斜坡，斜面（书面语）
vocabulary.example: He pushed the bike up a steep incline.
vocabulary.translation: 他推着自行车上了陡坡。

vocabulary.entry: technical /ˈteknɪkl/ adj. 技术性的，专业的
vocabulary.example: The course requires technical skills.
vocabulary.translation: 这门课程需要专业技能。

vocabulary.entry: tight /taɪt/ adj. 紧的，狭窄的
vocabulary.example: The road makes a tight turn ahead.
vocabulary.translation: 前方道路有一个急转弯。

vocabulary.entry: obstacle /ˈɒbstəkl/ n. 障碍，阻碍
vocabulary.example: A lack of qualifications can be a major obstacle to finding a job.
vocabulary.translation: 缺乏学历是找工作的一大障碍。

vocabulary.entry: qualifier /ˈkwɒlɪfaɪə(r)/ n. 合格者，取得资格的人
vocabulary.example: He is a strong qualifier for the final.
vocabulary.translation: 他是决赛的有力竞争者。

vocabulary.definition: （运动队的）小组成员，队伍（书面语）
vocabulary.entry: squad /skwɒd/ n. （运动队的）小组成员，队伍（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She was named in the national squad.
vocabulary.translation: 她被选入了国家队。

vocabulary.definition: 丝毫，任何（用于否定句后加强语气）（书面语）
vocabulary.entry: whatsoever /ˌwɒtsəʊˈevə(r)/ adv. 丝毫，任何（用于否定句后加强语气）（书面语）
vocabulary.example: There is no doubt whatsoever about his honesty.
vocabulary.translation: 对他的诚实没有任何疑问。

vocabulary.entry: man-made /ˌmæn ˈmeɪd/ adj. 人造的
vocabulary.example: The lake is man-made, not natural.
vocabulary.translation: 这个湖是人造的，不是天然的。

vocabulary.entry: berm /bɜːm/ n. 护堤，平台（滑雪术语）
vocabulary.example: The skiers launched off the berm.
vocabulary.translation: 滑雪者从护堤上起跳。

vocabulary.entry: oversee /ˌəʊvəˈsiː/ v. 监督，监管（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She oversees the marketing department.
vocabulary.translation: 她负责监督市场部门。

vocabulary.entry: regulation /ˌreɡjuˈleɪʃn/ n. 规章，法规（书面语）
vocabulary.example: New safety regulations have been introduced.
vocabulary.translation: 新的安全法规已经出台。

vocabulary.entry: promotion /prəˈməʊʃn/ n. 推广，促进
vocabulary.example: The band is on a European promotional tour.
vocabulary.translation: 这个乐队正在欧洲进行巡回推广。

vocabulary.definition: 巡回赛，巡回路线（书面语）
vocabulary.entry: circuit /ˈsɜːkɪt/ n. 巡回赛，巡回路线（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The tennis player won three titles on the circuit.
vocabulary.translation: 这位网球选手在巡回赛上赢得了三个冠军。

vocabulary.entry: continental /ˌkɒntɪˈnentl/ adj. 洲际的，大陆的
vocabulary.example: The continental championships are held every two years.
vocabulary.translation: 洲际锦标赛每两年举办一次。

vocabulary.entry: elevate /ˈelɪveɪt/ v. 提升，抬高（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The new job helped elevate her status in the company.
vocabulary.translation: 新工作帮助提升了她在公司的地位。

vocabulary.entry: standing /ˈstændɪŋ/ n. 地位，名声（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The university has a high standing in the academic world.
vocabulary.translation: 这所大学在学术界享有崇高地位。

vocabulary.definition: 肾上腺素（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.entry: adrenaline /əˈdrenəlɪn/ n. 肾上腺素（专业术语，书面语）
vocabulary.example: The excitement gave him an adrenaline rush.
vocabulary.translation: 兴奋让他肾上腺素飙升。

vocabulary.entry: look out for /ˌlʊk ˈaʊt fɔː(r)/ phr. v. 留心，注意（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Look out for falling rocks on the path.
vocabulary.translation: 当心路上有落石。
